category: consumer location intelligence / weather decision product
one_line_description: Live sunset intelligence that tells people if tonight is worth it, when to go, and where to watch nearby.
target_users: people deciding whether to watch tonight's sunset
people who care about parking, smell, access, and view quality
core_problem: Sunset decisions are time-sensitive and fragmented across weather, maps, drive time, local knowledge, and personal comfort.
core_solution: A compact location-aware dashboard with sunset score, peak window, afterglow estimate, leave-now guidance, ranked nearby spots, an upgraded option, a destination option, notifications, and shareable cards.
differentiation: Scores the full human sunset experience: clouds, humidity, visibility, wind, timing, smell, parking, ease, panorama, water presence, distance, and drive time.
mvp_scope: browser geolocation with saved-location and fallback modes

website.deployment: Manual Vercel production deploy only: pnpm install, pnpm build, vercel --prod

core_outputs: 1 wider-area destination option within about 1 hour

design_system.style: Apple-inspired, latest iOS widget aesthetic, glossy, translucent, compact, premium, cinematic, dark luxury

do_not: do not expose raw provider errors
do not require OpenAI for the homepage
do not expose Autobuilder details publicly
do not reintroduce homepage preferences panel
do not use premium as a spot tier unless all unions are intentionally updated

autobuilder_strategy.next_cycle_focus: replace deterministic fallback approximations with real sunset, weather, place, and drive-time data while preserving fallback-safe UX

last_recovery_summary.summary: Recovered production build target, restored SUNSETX homepage, stabilized live-score fallback JSON, aligned spot/report types, and wrote Autobuilder foundation files.
